literal_support: finite five original disease names; explicit self possibly/appears/suspected, self suspicion and doctor suspicion concerning self
subject_not_assumed: bare 可能有高血压 does not prove self; leave unclear subject for clarification
source: complete current user assertion preserving subject, uncertainty and raw time; full-message hash unchanged
complete_only_when: the quote protocol response is complete and valid
all supplied quotes are resolved without missing or ambiguous occurrences
a permitted local self-disease rule proves suspected/uncertain from a unique full source
no model proposal already refers to the same entity and no conflicting local assertion/time for it
candidate is absent from the already accepted set and total remains at most five
never_complete: malformed, incomplete or missing model response
family, hypothesis, quotation, question or unclear subject
duplicate source quote or same-entity model disagreement
ordinary confirmed/denied disease, medication, preference or arbitrary other information

audit.model_raw_results: immutable; never backfill raw extraction scores
audit.model_groundings: only real model-provided quotes; local completions do not invent model quotes
audit.local_uncertain_completion: policy version plus exact added candidate IDs
audit.effective_preview_digest: includes final candidates and completion metadata

storage: existing P01/P02 source, permission, version, transaction and same-attribute P04 guards still apply
